goal: Ensure nodes maintain enough outbound connections that relay transactions outside initial block download
Prevents peers that decline transaction relay from degrading broadcast topology unknowingly
agreement: Asks whether replacement peers should be validated before evicting existing peers (instagibbs)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because outbound slots can be occupied by non-relaying peers without operator knowledge
Improves transaction broadcast and network liveness by replacing them with functional peers
